text: Premier Padel was founded by Qatar Sports Investments (QSI) together with the International Padel Federation (FIP) and the Professional Padel Association, and launched in 2022; in August 2023 QSI acquired World Padel Tour to create a single global tour governed by FIP.

source.name: Premier Padel - Premier Padel announces multi-year partnership with Qatar Airways
source.quote: Premier Padel is the leading official professional padel tour worldwide, founded by Qatar Sports Investments (QSI) together with the International Padel Federation (FIP) and the Professional Padel Association (PPA)
